markets: Phoenix metro (Buckeye, Goodyear, Surprise, Peoria, Avondale, Queen Creek, Phoenix)
profile.org_note: Single-office, family-founded company with no divisions. It works as a fee general contractor and development manager for third-party build-to-rent owners, so the land is bought with and for the owner's capital. Founder Greg Hancock still personally handles land acquisition; Bobbi Johnson runs land development; Marianne Laupp is CFO; COO Janine Long covers land entitlement and investor relations.
profile.summary: NOT a conventional for-sale homebuilder. Hancock Builders (formerly Hancock Communities, founded 1976) is a private Phoenix general contractor and fee developer that builds single-family build-to-rent communities for third-party developers and investors (TerraLane/IHP Capital Partners, Cavan Companies, Blueprint Capital, Van Tuyl/Vlux, WestStone, Montgomery Street Partners, UrbanStreet); all 1,374 of its 2025 Builder 100 'closings' are rental units delivered to those owners. All work is in Arizona: 25 rental communities delivered since 2017 and 10 under construction as of September 2025. It is a weak land-banking prospect because the land sits on its clients' balance sheets, not its own, although founder Greg Hancock sources that land and the company says it plans to expand into for-sale and commercial contracting and to work with developers outside Arizona.

people.name: Greg Hancock
people.title: Founder and Chairman
people.source_title: Hancock Builders Announces Leadership Transition: Founder Greg Hancock Passes the Torch to CEO Kelly Whiteley (company announcement carried by Arizona Contractor & Community)
people.note: This is the land acquisition contact. He moved from CEO to Chairman in September 2025 and said he will keep focusing on land acquisition; the company team page (opened 2026-11-19) still titles him President and says he is responsible for all land acquisition plus product development and design. Title conflict between the two sources: the announcement is newer in substance, the team page appears not to have been updated. Title note: Company team page still shows 'President'.

people.name: Bobbi Johnson
people.title: Vice President of Land Development
people.prior_role: First joined Hancock in 2000; land development for master-planned communities using tax-based (district) financing for horizontal improvements, then returned to Hancock
people.note: Leads land development. Her bio credits her with more than 9,000 single-family lots produced over her career. Also named in the September 2025 leadership announcement. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: Marianne Laupp
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.prior_role: CFO of ICON Builders for 16 years; earlier Controller for Shiloh Custom Homes and The Boulders Residential Community (North Scottsdale)
people.note: Responsible for financial reporting, cash flow analysis and HR policy. Her background includes dealing with banks, insurers and bonding agencies. Also named as CFO in the September 2025 leadership announcement. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: Kelly Whiteley
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.prior_role: Operations executive at Hancock Builders; founder of MDU Technology Consultants (formerly known as Kelly Ward)
people.note: Named CEO in the announcement dated 2025-09-11; she is founder Greg Hancock's stepdaughter (Builder interview, 2025-09-26). Her bio says she is growing the general contracting business across Arizona (Phoenix, Tucson, Prescott Valley, Flagstaff, Yuma), and she has said she wants developers outside Arizona as clients. Reports to the founder/chairman by inference.

people.name: Janine Long
people.title: Chief Operations Officer
people.prior_role: With Hancock since 1987; background in resale, leasing, property management, mortgage financing, new home sales and land transactions
people.note: Relevant to a capital conversation: her bio says she handles land entitlement and investor relations as well as amenity design and internal operations. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: Steve Kunzweiler
people.title: Vice President of Forward Planning
people.prior_role: More than 25 years in municipal construction and real estate development; civil engineering degree and MBA
people.note: Forward planning (pre-development and entitlement pipeline). Also named in the September 2025 leadership announcement. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: DJ Hancock
people.title: Vice President of Construction
people.note: Son of founder Greg Hancock and the named next-generation family leader. The September 2025 announcement says he has led land development and construction field operations for the past five years; his bio credits him with 28 build-to-rent communities and more than 5,000 units, leading 25 project managers. Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.name: Dan Cauble
people.title: Vice President of Purchasing
people.prior_role: More than 35 years in homebuilding purchasing, 24 of them in the Phoenix market
people.note: Also named in the September 2025 leadership announcement. Reporting line inferred from titles.
